title: Uncaught TypeError: y is not a function - bundled version of preact@10.0.5 errors when executing code compiled with Webpack
body:
**Describe the bug 🐛**
We just upgraded InstantSearch from 3.x to 4.0.1 and have everything working great...except in production where our code is compiled _and minified_ using Webpack with Terser.

When using `search.addWidgets([...])`, instantsearch invokes `preact` code which causes the TypeError shown below.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/22938/70348832-c2890080-1820-11ea-9aad-2189bddc6217.png)

Don't ask me why but downgrading to exactly `preact@10.0.1` makes the issue go away.

**To Reproduce 🔍**
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. instantsearch@4.0.1, preact@10.0.5 (or really any version > 10.0.1)
2. Compile code with gulp webpack-stream 5.2.1 using latest Terser plugin minimizer with default settings
3. Use `search.addWidgets` (need to be at least 1 `refinementList` widget) to trigger preact code
4. Load page
